headline: Elon Musk said at an event that he has had 'AI psychosis' about half a dozen times this year.
score_reason: Musk's own quoted remark makes it newsworthy, but it comes through a commentary piece; pool score kept.
importance_line: It shows a leading tech figure describing AI-related delusion in himself, but AI psychosis is not a recognised medical condition.
summary: Business Insider reports, as relayed by The A.V. Club, that Elon Musk, owner of X and chief of SpaceX and Tesla, said at a Twitter event that he has had 'AI or SI psychosis probably like half a dozen times' this year and 'a little bit of cyber psychosis'. The A.V. Club's satirical commentary notes that AI psychosis is not a medically recognised condition and that Musk then praised AI-generated music.
notes: Source chain: Business Insider (first reporter) via A.V. Club commentary. Event date not stated.
